items.question: Can we determine whether an engine was under warranty on the failure date?
prerequisites: Mapped engine and failure-date observations
Versioned policy, coverage, exclusions and valid required inputs

items.question: Can we identify why a claim was rejected?
prerequisites: Mapped claims, rejection decisions, reasons and evidence

items.question: Can we retrieve all claims for a particular OEM?
prerequisites: Mapped claim-to-OEM associations with verified identifiers

items.question: Can we distinguish customer-reported information from verified information?
prerequisites: Mapped assertions with reported/verified status and source provenance

items.question: Can we determine which warranty policy version was used for an approval?
prerequisites: Mapped decision-to-policy-version links and temporal applicability

items.question: Can we identify which engineer investigated a particular engine?
prerequisites: Mapped engine, service case, investigation and engineer assignments

items.question: Can we retrieve all observations from a joint inspection?
prerequisites: Mapped joint inspections and their observation records

items.question: Can we compare complaint details with actual inspection findings?
prerequisites: Mapped complaint and inspection findings with distinct evidence status

items.question: Can we identify previous failures of the same engine?
prerequisites: Resolved physical-engine identity and dated failure history

items.question: Can we identify unresolved investigations?
prerequisites: Mapped investigations and explicit unresolved/completion status

items.question: Can we find all engines with the same confirmed failure mechanism?
prerequisites: Mapped engines and confirmed failure mechanisms with supporting evidence

items.question: Can we identify all returned engines associated with a particular quality issue?
prerequisites: Mapped return records and verified quality-issue associations

items.question: Can we trace a root cause back to the original complaint and evidence?
prerequisites: Verified complaint-to-investigation-to-root-cause evidence path

items.question: Can we identify whether the same component has failed across different engine models?
prerequisites: Mapped component, engine-model and comparable confirmed-failure identities

items.question: Can we identify all engines affected by a particular engineering change?
prerequisites: Mapped engineering changes, applicability scope and engine incorporation evidence

items.question: Can we determine the exact serial-number boundary for a change?
prerequisites: Versioned engineering-change scope and typed serial boundaries

items.question: Can we identify engines that were manufactured after cut-in but did not receive the required change?
prerequisites: Mapped manufacture/cut-in dates and actual change-incorporation evidence

items.question: Can we detect confirmed failures after corrective action implementation?
prerequisites: Confirmed comparable failures, corrective-action incorporation and operating exposure

items.question: Which engine models have the highest warranty failure rates?
prerequisites: Mapped warranty failure population and valid exposure/denominator by engine model

items.question: Which root causes generate the highest replacement costs?
prerequisites: Confirmed cause-to-replacement associations and comparable cost/currency records

items.question: Which corrective actions have not demonstrated effectiveness?
prerequisites: Mapped corrective actions, implementation dates, populations and effectiveness criteria

items.question: Which OEMs experience the highest recurrence rates?
prerequisites: Verified OEM recurrence cohorts, comparable failures and exposure denominators
